role: Read-only quarterly oil curve, complete instrument histories, and a reserved standard-futures specification for the monthly game.

reference.monthly.note: Complete visible spot-reference OHLC from 2025 through the cutoff.

mainContinuous.monthly.note: Complete backward-ratio-adjusted main OHLC from 2025; rolls before the expiry month.

curve.contracts[].monthly.note: Named contract OHLC from listing through the cutoff or expiry, at most 15 monthly and 60 weekly bars.

invariants: exactly five quarterly contracts are listed
one standard lot represents 1000 barrels and one minimum tick is 10 USD per lot
margin rates are reserved parameters and are not enforced while orders are disabled
the expiry month is settlement-only and uses the visible spot reference close
each named contract lists 14 calendar months before expiry and has 15 inclusive monthly settlements
a named expiry-month contract converges to the visible spot reference
the main series rolls to the next quarter for the expiry-month bar
the main series is backward-ratio-adjusted and non-tradable
curve factors are persistent long slope, near pressure, and curvature states
pricing reads only visible monthly oil bars and the latest completed annual macro row
no future monthly close or later annual macro state is used at a cutoff
no player, order, position, or portfolio state is a pricing input
no write-back to global macro or commodity overlay
